aetherscope.title: AetherScope
aetherscope.subtitle: Deep Space Exploration & Spectral Analysis Platform
aetherscope.description: Interactive deep-space exploration platform and spectroscopic laboratory. Features a 360° WebGL2 sky viewer powered by Aladin Lite (Rust/WASM) to navigate massive astronomical catalogs and blend multi-wavelength survey data in real time with Supabase persistence.
highlights: 360° WebGL2 sky viewer with real-time multi-spectral blending (JWST Infrared, Hubble/DSS2 Optical, Chandra X-Ray).
Zero-latency streaming of hierarchical progressive HiPS tile pipelines (CDS / ESA / NASA).
Spectroscopic laboratory module to infer physical phenomena, chemical composition, with user cataloging and JSON data exports.

rescuesync.title: RescueSync / DSSD
rescuesync.subtitle: Distributed Emergency Coordination & Real-Time Resource Allocation Platform
rescuesync.description: Distributed platform designed to coordinate disaster response, managing regional risk tiers, critical brigade resource stocks, and credential validation for NGOs via business process orchestration.
highlights: Decoupled microservice architecture with Java Spring Boot and ACID transactional persistence on PostgreSQL.
Contingency orchestration powered by Bonita BPM REST API for credential review and disaster mitigation pipelines.
Pessimistic concurrency locking for medical supply allocation with multi-tenant JWT Role-Based Access Control.

alquilando.title: Alquilando
alquilando.subtitle: Vehicle Rental Management System & Fleet Availability Engine
alquilando.description: Comprehensive backend system for vehicle fleet reservation and rental management, implementing business logic to prevent temporal overbooking, handle dynamic pricing, and maintain relational referential integrity.
highlights: Optimized relational schema in PostgreSQL with composite indexing delivering sub-millisecond query execution.
Strict business logic in Django/Python validating non-overlapping date ranges and referential integrity constraints.
Granular role-based permissions separating fleet operators, administrative staff, and end customers.
